phase_name: Lifecycle Bootstrap & Session State Reporting Repair
summary: Root-caused and repaired the lifecycle bootstrap/reporting inconsistency family: the phase-ID grammar used throughout pcae.core.phase_reports/architecture_status/context/tasks and pcae.commands.phase assumed exactly one mainline branch letter, which cannot parse the two-letter mainline suffixes Track 136 now uses (136Z -> 136AA -> ... -> 136AW) -- the direct, live-reproduced cause of "## Current Phase section present but its phase-ID/title line did not parse" and dropped/truncated Recommended Next Phase text. Unified to a one-or-more-letter grammar everywhere, fixed wrapped-title truncation with a new two-tier _match_current_phase_declaration() shared by build_architecture_status(), pcae governance audit's current-phase check, and pcae.commands.task's lifecycle current-phase reader (replacing three/four independently-broken reimplementations), and closed three malformed-metadata crash/fabrication gaps in pcae phase complete/pcae task finish (non-int/non-list files_changed, explicit-null validation_results/governance_results, non-dict list items). pcae session bootstrap now also surfaces the last completed phase's own notification dispatch outcome distinctly from Telegram sink configuration. Added the missing 'Recommended next phase:' sentence to PROJECT_STATUS.md's 136AW entry so pcae session bootstrap and pcae architecture-status inspect now agree (both show 137A). Live-verified against this repository's own real PROJECT_STATUS.md before and after (see docs). Two genuine regressions surfaced and were repaired during this phase's own verification (a marker-required current-phase grammar that rejected a legitimate no-status-marker declaration shape, and a masked identical single-letter bug in tests/test_rc_audit_findings_repair.py's own test helper, unmasked once the production comparison started working). No Stage 3 schema or typed-authority-model change; no runtime capability change.
